question:
Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.

The child develops a __deadly__ disease.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4 i.e. (Fatal)'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word in the sentence, "deadly," is an adjective that means likely causing or causing death; fatal or lethal. (घातक)
 
• "Fatal," the selected synonym, also signifies something that causes death or that has resulted in somebody's death.(घातक)

Therefore, the correct answer is- 'Fatal'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Huge" (विशाल) refers to something very large in size, amount, or degree.
 
• "Corrective" (सुधारात्मक) means designed to correct or counteract something harmful or undesirable.
 
• "Kind" (दयालु) refers to a sympathetic, friendly, or generous nature.
